title: Framework CI-security workflows are incompatible with the canonical strict YAML workflow-security contract
title_de: Framework-CI-Sicherheits-Workflows sind mit dem kanonischen strikten YAML-Workflow-Sicherheitsvertrag inkompatibel
summary: After #27 was reconciled with the #29 workflow checker, its CI-security workflows retained flow-style YAML collections. The canonical checker deliberately rejects those collections fail-closed because block mappings keep workflow permissions and action pins reviewable. The incompatibility is distinct from the FND-FRAMEWORK-0013 permission invariant and the FND-FRAMEWORK-0016 downloader-locking boundary.
summary_de: Nachdem #27 mit dem #29-Workflow-Checker abgeglichen wurde, behielten seine CI-Sicherheits-Workflows Flow-Style-YAML-Collections. Der kanonische Checker lehnt diese Collections absichtlich fail-closed ab, weil Block-Mappings Workflow-Berechtigungen und Action-Pins reviewbar halten. Die Inkompatibilität ist von der Berechtigungsinvariante FND-FRAMEWORK-0013 und der Downloader-Lock-Grenze FND-FRAMEWORK-0016 verschieden.
observed_behavior: The retained pre-fix canonical checker exits 1 and reports flow-style YAML collection violations at ci-security-codeql lines 5, 7, and 30; ci-security-dependency-review line 5; ci-security-osv line 5; ci-security-quality line 5; ci-security-scorecard lines 5 and 7; ci-security-secrets line 5; ci-security-workflow-lint line 5; and cleanup-artifacts line 8.
observed_behavior_de: Der aufbewahrte Pre-Fix-Canonical-Checker beendet sich mit Exit 1 und meldet Flow-Style-YAML-Collection-Verletzungen bei ci-security-codeql Zeilen 5, 7 und 30; ci-security-dependency-review Zeile 5; ci-security-osv Zeile 5; ci-security-quality Zeile 5; ci-security-scorecard Zeilen 5 und 7; ci-security-secrets Zeile 5; ci-security-workflow-lint Zeile 5; sowie cleanup-artifacts Zeile 8.
expected_behavior: All Framework workflow YAML covered by the strict contract uses canonical block mappings. The checker remains fail-closed for any flow-style collection while legitimate block-mapped workflow permissions and SHA-pinned actions remain accepted.
expected_behavior_de: Sämtliches vom strikten Contract abgedeckte Framework-Workflow-YAML verwendet kanonische Block-Mappings. Der Checker bleibt für jede Flow-Style-Collection fail-closed, während legitime blockgemappte Workflow-Berechtigungen und SHA-gepinnte Actions akzeptiert bleiben.
impact: Flow-style collections obscure permission and action-pin review boundaries and are explicitly forbidden by the Framework's canonical strict workflow-security contract. Permitting them would weaken a security control and make syntax-equivalent but less reviewable workflow changes easier to introduce.
impact_de: Flow-Style-Collections verschleiern Review-Grenzen für Berechtigungen und Action-Pins und sind durch den kanonischen strikten Workflow-Sicherheitsvertrag des Frameworks ausdrücklich verboten. Ihre Zulassung würde einen Security-Control schwächen und syntaktisch äquivalente, aber weniger reviewbare Workflow-Änderungen erleichtern.
preconditions: Framework PR #27 agent/expand-framework-ci-security was normally reconciled with Framework origin/master 7a12073c28e62a67492dd501b6513b9914fe5df8.
The retained diagnostics were captured after the ten textual merge conflicts were resolved and before the #27-owned workflow compatibility repair.
The #29 canonical checker is intentionally strict and fail-closed; no Parent or MRTS path was changed.

required_diagnostics: .github/workflows/ci-security-codeql.yml:5: flow-style YAML collections are prohibited in workflows; use block mappings for reviewable action pins
.github/workflows/ci-security-scorecard.yml:7: flow-style YAML collections are prohibited in workflows; use block mappings for reviewable action pins
.github/workflows/cleanup-artifacts.yml:8: flow-style YAML collections are prohibited in workflows; use block mappings for reviewable action pins

evidence.scope_note: Current pre-fix #27/#29 workflow-contract compatibility evidence; the exact observation minute was not retained in the supplied receipt.

evidence.summary: Current Framework master 47e50e7bc43ba7a3b5bad1a9448111794f664cc0 passes the strict fail-closed syntax contract and focused negative/legitimate block-mapping controls; PR #27 and resulting-master checks are successful.

root_cause: PR #27's CI-security workflow syntax predates or was not fully reconciled to the #29 canonical strict checker. Flow-style YAML mappings survived the normal branch reconciliation, creating a deterministic contract failure rather than a reason to loosen the checker.
root_cause_de: Die CI-Sicherheits-Workflow-Syntax von PR #27 geht dem #29-kanonischen strikten Checker voraus oder wurde nicht vollständig mit ihm abgeglichen. Flow-Style-YAML-Mappings überstanden den normalen Branch-Abgleich und erzeugen damit einen deterministischen Contract-Fehler statt eines Grundes, den Checker zu lockern.
proposed_remediation: Convert every listed flow-style YAML collection to the canonical equivalent block mapping in the #27-owned workflow files. Preserve scanner coverage, pinned action identities, the strict checker, and the distinct FND-FRAMEWORK-0013 permission remediation; do not add an exception or broaden the accepted syntax.
proposed_remediation_de: Jede aufgeführte Flow-Style-YAML-Collection in den #27-eigenen Workflow-Dateien in das kanonische äquivalente Block-Mapping überführen. Scanner-Coverage, gepinnte Action-Identitäten, den strikten Checker und die separate Berechtigungsremediation FND-FRAMEWORK-0013 erhalten; keine Ausnahme hinzufügen und die akzeptierte Syntax nicht erweitern.
acceptance_criteria: Every listed workflow has no flow-style YAML collection covered by the strict workflow-security contract.
The canonical checker remains fail-closed and passes --check all on the final #27 exact head.
Focused negative regression controls continue to reject flow-style mappings.
Legitimate block-mapped permissions and SHA-pinned action definitions remain accepted.
Fresh exact-head PR checks and the resulting-master rerun verify the repaired workflow set without weakening the checker.
validation_plan: Rerun the retained canonical reproducer after the #27 syntax repair; it must exit 0 without checker changes that broaden accepted YAML syntax.
Run focused workflow-contract regressions that reject flow-style collections and accept canonical block mappings.
Run applicable local workflow/lint checks, then observe fresh exact-head PR checks and rerun the original reproduction plus legitimate controls on resulting Framework master.
legitimate_control_tests: Canonical block-mapped top-level and job permissions remain accepted.
SHA-pinned actions expressed with canonical block mappings remain accepted.
The strict checker still rejects a representative flow-style YAML collection.
dependencies: FND-FRAMEWORK-0013 permission remediation remains distinct and must also pass
Fresh exact-head PR checks and review evidence
Resulting Framework master original-reproduction and legitimate-control rerun
residual_risk: The current reconciled #27 pre-fix workflow set fails the strict syntax contract. No post-fix local, exact-head remote, or resulting-master evidence exists yet. The strict checker is deliberately not waived or weakened.
residual_risk_de: Der aktuelle abgeglichene Pre-Fix-Workflow-Satz von #27 scheitert am strikten Syntax-Contract. Es existiert noch keine Post-Fix-lokale, Exact-Head-Remote- oder Resulting-Master-Evidence. Der strikte Checker wird ausdrücklich weder waived noch geschwächt.

history.detail: A distinct fail-closed flow-style YAML compatibility finding was created from retained #27/#29 reconciliation diagnostics. No current remediation or remote verification is claimed.

PR #27 exact-head and resulting-master checks were confirmed successful, and current master 47e50e7bc43ba7a3b5bad1a9448111794f664cc0 passed the strict flow-style rejection and legitimate block-mapping controls without weakening the checker.
